title: First Meeting JR Amiga

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Criminal Behavioral Implants? They're pretty new. Some neuroscientists noticed most criminals had pretty crummy childhoods, so they started implanting them with happy memories to see if they could change them from the ground up.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Criminal Behavioral Implants? They're pretty new. Some neuroscientists noticed most criminals had pretty crummy childhoods, so they started implanting them with happy memories to see if they could change them from the ground up.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: The only thing that will be selling out is my debut novel "Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The only thing that will be selling out is my debut novel "Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity."

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Do you have any of that underground digitally-enhanced neuro-coffee at your place? I've not slept in three days.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you have any of that underground digitally-enhanced neuro-coffee at your place? I've not slept in three days.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: I just hope my novel: 'Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity.' finally gets published. It could be worse. I could be working in a ramen stand or something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I just hope my novel: 'Breadline Blues - Tips on Poverty Positivity.' finally gets published. It could be worse. I could be working in a ramen stand or something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No that stuff is illegal. What are you working on?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No that stuff is illegal. What are you working on?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No that stuff is illegal. What are you working on?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No that stuff is illegal. What are you working on?

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Oh, this? I'm working on… It's fiction.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, this? I'm working on… It's fiction.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A novel?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A novel?

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Yes… Well no… I'm writing CBI's while I'm between agents. Just putting potatoes on the table.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes… Well no… I'm writing CBI's while I'm between agents. Just putting potatoes on the table.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Remind me, what is a CBI?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Remind me, what is a CBI?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Remind me, what is a CBI?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Remind me, what is a CBI?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aren't they dangerous?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aren't they dangerous?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like a good idea!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you're not really a writer then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you're not really a writer then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you're not really a writer then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you're not really a writer then.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: They've had some positive results... Sure, a few people have had neural meltdowns, a few didn't make it off the table.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They've had some positive results... Sure, a few people have had neural meltdowns, a few didn't make it off the table.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Like you'd know. Can't imagine running a noodle stand requires much reading.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Like you'd know. Can't imagine running a noodle stand requires much reading.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens to the real memories?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happens to the real memories?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happens to the real memories?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happens to the real memories?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like it could have moral implications.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like it could have moral implications.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Sounds like it could have moral implications.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Sounds like it could have moral implications.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Moral implications? Try getting cheated out of the advance of your first novel because it was deemed too "politically offensive".

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Moral implications? Try getting cheated out of the advance of your first novel because it was deemed too "politically offensive".

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That does sound rough.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That does sound rough.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like you sold out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like you sold out.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: I have no idea, but the way I see it, if I'm doing my job well, they won't care.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have no idea, but the way I see it, if I'm doing my job well, they won't care.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can lost memories be retrieved?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can lost memories be retrieved?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: None taken.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: None taken.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: Good... good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good... good.

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: That's... look... I'm just really busy here. This isn't noodle cooking, formative childhood experiences don't write themselves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's... look... I'm just really busy here. This isn't noodle cooking, formative childhood experiences don't write themselves.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A holo-theater piece?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A holo-theater piece?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ouch!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could have written a comedy!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could have written a comedy!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could have written a comedy!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could have written a comedy!

nodes.speaker: JR Amiga
nodes.text: and then getting dumped by your agent for being too "verbally offensive", all while your father has cut you off the credit cards. How does that sound morally?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: and then getting dumped by your agent for being too "verbally offensive", all while your father has cut you off the credit cards. How does that sound morally?
